newsletter.intro: Mimi loves collecting beautiful leaves, seeds, and shiny stones, but she worries they're too small to be good gifts. When she discovers that the tiny leaf she gave to Koko is his most treasured possession, Mimi learns a beautiful lesson: gifts from the heart are always special, no matter their size.

learning_words.meaning: TREASURE 寶物 Something very special to you This tiny leaf is a treasure.
THANKFUL 感謝 Feeling happy someone gave you something
GIFT 禮物 Something special you give someone A leaf can be a special gift.

Koko's Forest · EP008

Mimi's Tiny Treasures

Mimi loves collecting beautiful leaves, seeds, and shiny stones, but she worries they're too small to be good gifts. When she discovers that the tiny leaf she gave to Koko is his most treasured possession, Mimi learns a beautiful lesson: gifts from the heart are always special, no matter their size.

Learning words

TREASURE
TREASURE		 TREASURE 寶物 Something very special to you This tiny leaf is a treasure.
Practice TREASURE together.
THANKFUL
THANKFUL		 THANKFUL 感謝 Feeling happy someone gave you something
Practice THANKFUL together.
GIFT
GIFT		 GIFT 禮物 Something special you give someone A leaf can be a special gift.
Practice GIFT together.

Parent activity

Daily mission / 每日任務: Say: "This tiny leaf is a treasure." 這片小葉子是寶物。 Role play / 角色扮演: Act out Mimi giving Koko a tiny leaf. Ask: Why can a small gift be special? 演一演米米把小葉子送給叩叩,問問孩子:為什麼小禮物也可以很特別? Tip / 小提醒: Gifts from the heart are always special, no matter their size. Quick quiz / 小測驗: What does "TREASURE" mean? / "TREASURE" 是什麼意思? A. Something very special to you / 對你很特別的東西 B. Happy / 高興 C.
